segments.ja441:1.1: Yo kopaneyye na karoti kopaṃ, na kujjhati sappuriso kadāci;
segments.ja441:1.3: Kuddhopi so nāvikaroti kopaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇamāhu [samaṇaṃ āhu (sī.)] loke.
segments.ja441:2.1: Ūnūdaro yo sahate jighacchaṃ, danto tapassī mitapānabhojano;
segments.ja441:2.3: Āhārahetu na karoti pāpaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇamāhu loke.
segments.ja441:3.1: Khiḍḍaṃ ratiṃ vippajahitvāna sabbaṃ, na cālikaṃ bhāsasi kiñci loke;
segments.ja441:3.3: Vibhūsaṭṭhānā virato methunasmā, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇamāhu loke.
segments.ja441:4.1: Pariggahaṃ lobhadhammañca sabbaṃ, yo ve pariññāya pariccajeti;
segments.ja441:4.3: Dantaṃ ṭhitattaṃ amamaṃ nirāsaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇamāhu loke.
segments.ja441:5.1: Pucchāma kattāramanomapaññaṃ [manomapañña (syā. ka.)], kathāsu no viggaho atthi jāto;
segments.ja441:5.3: Chindajja kaṅkhaṃ vicikicchitāni, tadajja [tayājja (sī.)] kaṅkhaṃ vitaremu sabbe.
segments.ja441:6.1: Ye paṇḍitā atthadasā bhavanti, bhāsanti te yoniso tattha kāle;
segments.ja441:6.3: Kathaṃ nu kathānaṃ abhāsitānaṃ, atthaṃ nayeyyuṃ kusalā janindā.
segments.ja441:7.1: Kathaṃ have bhāsati nāgarājā, garuḷo pana venateyyo kimāha;
segments.ja441:7.3: Gandhabbarājā pana kiṃ vadesi, kathaṃ pana kurūnaṃ rājaseṭṭho.
segments.ja441:8.1: Khantiṃ have bhāsati nāgarājā, appāhāraṃ garuḷo venateyyo;
segments.ja441:9.1: Sabbāni etāni subhāsitāni, na hettha dubbhāsitamatthi kiñci;
segments.ja441:9.3: Yasmiñca etāni patiṭṭhitāni, arāva nābhyā susamohitāni;
segments.ja441:9.5: Catubbhi dhammehi samaṅgibhūtaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇamāhu loke.
segments.ja441:10.1: Tuvañhi [tuvaṃ nu (sī. pī.)] seṭṭho tvamanuttarosi, tvaṃ dhammagū dhammavidū sumedho;
segments.ja441:10.3: Paññāya pañhaṃ samadhiggahetvā, acchecchi dhīro vicikicchitāni;
segments.ja441:10.5: Acchecchi kaṅkhaṃ vicikicchitāni, cundo yathā nāgadantaṃ kharena.
segments.ja441:11.1: Nīluppalābhaṃ vimalaṃ anagghaṃ, vatthaṃ idaṃ dhūmasamānavaṇṇaṃ;
segments.ja441:11.3: Pañhassa veyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho, dadāmi te dhammapūjāya dhīra.
segments.ja441:12.3: Pañhassa veyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho, dadāmi te dhammapūjāya dhīra.
segments.ja441:13.1: Maṇiṃ anagghaṃ ruciraṃ pabhassaraṃ, kaṇṭhāvasattaṃ [vasitaṃ (ka.)] maṇibhūsitaṃ me;
segments.ja441:13.3: Pañhassa veyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho, dadāmi te dhammapūjāya dhīra.
segments.ja441:14.1: Gavaṃ sahassaṃ usabhañca nāgaṃ, ājaññayutte ca rathe dasa ime;
segments.ja441:14.3: Pañhassa veyyākaraṇena tuṭṭho, dadāmi te gāmavarāni soḷasa.
segments.ja441:15.1: Sāriputto tadā nāgo, supaṇṇo pana kolito;
segments.ja441:15.5: Vidhuro bodhisatto ca, evaṃ dhāretha jātakanti.
